name: Glenice Tan
biography: Glenice is a security researcher that enjoys exploring the quirks of different systems, applications, and processes. In the past year, she had the opportunity to conduct social engineering exercises, which includes phishing and vishing. Apart from applications and human hacking, she also experiments on ways to automate or improve red team operations.
